title: Home Comfort Financing Desk Memo: Financed Amount and the Progress Base of Replacement System Installations
content:
# Financed amount excluded from the progress base

## Rule

The financed exclusion of a Replacement System Installations progress installment follows the Home Comfort Financing account linked to the project:

- where the account is in approved status and its amount financed is below the project's net amount, the amount financed is excluded from the progress base;
- where the account is in approved status and its amount financed is at or above the net amount, the whole net amount is excluded and no progress share is owed;
- with no account in approved status, nothing is excluded.

The project's net amount is every charge on the project less every credit on it. The account's status and amount financed are read from the Home Comfort Financing account record.

## Decision grid

| Linked account status | Amount financed against the net amount | Excluded from the progress base |
|---|---|---|
| Approved | Below | The amount financed |
| Approved | Equal to | The whole net amount |
| Approved | Above | The whole net amount |
| Any status other than approved, or no linked account | — | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical projects)

- Net amount $13000.00; approved account with $9000.00 financed: $9000.00 is excluded.
- Net amount $13000.00; approved account with $13000.00 financed: the whole $13000.00 is excluded and no progress share is owed.
- Net amount $13000.00; account in active status with $9000.00 financed: nothing is excluded, because the account is not in approved status.
- Net amount $13000.00; declined account: nothing is excluded.
